---
title: "Syntax highlighting"
engine: pari-gp
format: html
---

Every construct below is highlighted by `pari-gp.xml`, which is generated from
the installed gp. The block is not executed: highlighting is a separate
component from execution, and this case tests only the former.

```gp
\\ a line comment
/* a block comment
   spanning two lines */
\p 38
?factor
E = ellinit([0, -1, 1, 0, 0]);
E.disc
mask = 0xFF;
eps = 1.23e-10;
for (n = 1, 10, print(nextprime(n)));
"a string with an \n escape"
```

One executed cell, so that the document still exercises the engine:

```{gp}
bnfinit(x^2 + 1).no
```
